name: Chemistry
description: Draw a structure in any field, catch a compound that is already registered (salts and solvents set aside), and find compounds by substructure or similarity.
author: Sheetbase

operations.title: Describe a structure
operations.description: Gives the formula, the mass and the parent structure of a molfile or a SMILES line, with the salts and solvents that came with it.

inputs.name: structure
inputs.description: A molfile or a SMILES line.

field-types.title: Chemical structure
field-types.description: A drawn structure, kept as a molfile. Draw it, or paste a SMILES line.

sameness-keys.title: Same parent structure
sameness-keys.description: Two compounds are the same when their parent structure is the same: the largest piece, neutralised, with salts and solvents set aside.

search-providers.title: Structure search
search-providers.description: Type sub: or sim: and a SMILES line to find compounds that contain it or look like it.

pages.title: Structure search
pages.description: Draw a structure to find the compounds that contain it or look like it.

record-hooks.title: Index structures
record-hooks.description: Keeps a fast index of each compound's structure so structure search stays quick with many compounds.
